title: Final answer
description: Essential: The response must give the correct final expression for the rate of change of the shadow length, which is Lv/(h-L).

title: Similar triangles setup
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply similar triangles to relate the person's position to the tip of the shadow.

title: Shadow length expression
description: Important: The solution must derive an expression for the shadow length (SM) as a function of time before differentiating.

title: Differentiation step
description: Important: The solution must correctly differentiate the shadow length expression with respect to time.

title: Person's position
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly state the person's horizontal distance from the pole as vt.

title: Incorrect triangle ratio
description: Pitfall: Deduct points if the similar triangles ratio is set up incorrectly (e.g., h/(h-L) inverted).

title: Sign or algebra error
description: Pitfall: Deduct points for algebraic mistakes in combining terms to find SM or its derivative.
